name: mailbox-manager
description: Local-first multi-account mailbox manager for Gmail, Yahoo and IMAP/SMTP.

scripts.check: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/google-oauth-flow.js && node --check src/google-account.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/message-export.js && node --check tools/mailbox-apk-request-v2.mjs
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release:signed: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
